purpose: Prove credibility with a static wall of real third-party logos: who backs the company (About, Startups) or where the team has worked before (Careers).

behaviour.note: Three different implementations of a static logo grid. About shows 2 large investor tiles (aspect 635/422, PNG, object-cover) on a gray-2 band with a pattern strip. Careers shows 16 employer SVG logos on a dark section (dark token scope) in a 3-column (4 from md) grid. Startups shows 21 investor PNG logos (372x282) in a 3/4/5/7-column grid, but only as a block inside content.qualification-terms, not as its own section.
Careers variant is dark: the section carries the dark class so tokens flip; the logo files themselves are drawn for that background. Adjacent Careers sections are gray-2 (before) and gray-2 (after).
Logos are not links and have no hover state. Logos are real company trademarks; only reference existing files.

variants.name: investors-2up
variants.description: About. Two large investor tiles in a 2-column grid (1 column below sm) on a gray-2 band with a top pattern strip. Section label plus a short bold lead line.

variants.name: employers-dark-grid
variants.description: Careers. Dark section: label, lead sentence, 16 employer logos in a 3-column (4 from md) grid, aspect 100/66 (100/60 from lg).

variants.name: investors-small-grid
variants.description: Startups. 21 small investor logos in a 3/4/5/7-column grid. Not a standalone section: rendered inside content.qualification-terms.

label.note: Eyebrow label with an icon; present on About and Careers only. Observed 2 to 3 words.

lead.note: Bold lead line; About observed 4 words, Careers 10 words. Absent in the startups block.

investorLogos.note: Used by investors-2up (2 items) and investors-small-grid (21 items).

employerLogos.note: Used by employers-dark-grid (16 items): logos of companies team members previously worked at.

patternStrip.note: Top pattern strip on About (pattern-11) and Careers (pattern-08).

motion.reducedMotionNote: No motion in the source; no prefers-reduced-motion handling exists in the code.
